relationship_to_base_contracts.scope: This addendum creates one exposed planning prefix before final IR-127 allocation. The frozen sampling frame remains controlling for eligibility, strata, rank, rights review, target blindness, and replacements; the split protocol remains controlling for the later final sample.
relationship_to_base_contracts.limited_override: Only the sampling-frame rule that no document is selected before final IR-127 allocation is superseded, and only for the planning prefix defined here.
relationship_to_base_contracts.no_retroactivity: This addendum is accepted before source acquisition, target search, annotation, model prediction, or outcome inspection.

training_only_pilot.purpose: Find guide, inventory, task-order, agreement-procedure, and burden defects before the guide is frozen.
training_only_pilot.material_rule: Use lawful project-authored or already exposed development material. Purposeful category/discontinuity coverage is allowed because this material is not a population sample.
training_only_pilot.prohibited_use: Do not use its target prevalence, document clustering, canonical-type richness, or category mix as an estimate of the frozen Wikipedia sampling population.

representative_planning_pilot.purpose: After IR-149 freezes the guide, estimate prevalence, document clustering, canonical-type richness, task-specific agreement, and burden for IR-127.
representative_planning_pilot.material_rule: Use only the target-blind probability-sampled prefix below. Every row is exposed development evidence and is permanently excluded from the sealed test.
representative_planning_pilot.prohibited_use: Do not tune a system on a planning-pilot result and then report that same result as held-out performance.

planning_prefix.unit: One immutable English Wikipedia page/revision document.
planning_prefix.eligible_pool: Rights-pass, structurally eligible, target-unexposed rows in each frozen short, medium, and long sampling queue.
prerequisites: The institutional human-work determination or approval covers the exact annotation workflow.
The IR-147 training-only pilot is complete and its raw labels, agreement, and task-time evidence are frozen.
IR-149 has frozen the annotation guide and adjudication rules.
Realized rights-pass N_h is recorded for short, medium, and long without target search.
A feasible total planning-pilot document ceiling M is calculated from the observed IR-147 task time, double annotation, QA, adjudication, retraining, and reserve budget.
A new decision-log record freezes M, m_h, document identities, input hashes, annotator roles, and guide version before any planning-prefix target exposure.
allocation_rule: Fail if any realized N_h is below 6, M is below 18, or M exceeds the total realized N_h.
Assign six planning documents to each length stratum.
Let remaining capacity c_h equal N_h minus six and remaining allocation R equal M minus 18.
Allocate floor(R*c_h/sum(c_h)) additional documents to each stratum, then assign any remainder by descending fractional remainder; ties use short, medium, long order.
If sum(c_h) is zero, M must equal 18.
planning_prefix.selection_rule: For each stratum, freeze the first m_h rights-pass, target-unexposed documents in the existing deterministic queue. Rights hold/fail rows are skipped before target exposure and remain recorded; no observed MWE, category, continuity, sense, agreement, burden, model, or downstream value may select, replace, or reorder a document.
planning_prefix.stopping_rule: Annotate the entire frozen prefix. Do not stop early, extend it, or replace a document because a target category, discontinuous occurrence, canonical form, agreement value, or burden result is absent or unfavorable.
planning_prefix.analysis_rule: Use inclusion-probability weights and the frozen document/canonical-type cluster contracts. If the prefix is sparse or yields undefined inputs, IR-127 withholds the affected claim; it does not add target-selected documents.
planning_prefix.post_pilot_rule: Remove every planning-prefix identity from the eligible final-sample queue before applying the final IR-127 allocation and IR-123 split. Preserve the exclusion and exposure records publicly without publishing protected working files.

exposure_and_release.ledger_rule: Before annotation, append one planning-prefix exposure group; after materialization, create one item-level exposure record per document.
exposure_and_release.release_rule: Release only layers that pass the existing page-level rights, attribution, privacy, and institutional gates. This addendum itself contains no source text or human-derived data.
exposure_and_release.claim_ceiling: The protocol resolves the pilot-design route only. It supplies no N_h, M, m_h, document, label, prevalence, agreement, burden, precision, or benchmark-performance result.

change_rule: Any change to pilot separation, eligibility, minimums, allocation, queue order, stopping, exposure, or sealed-test exclusion requires a new prospective addendum before affected target exposure.
